title: Upload a replay
description: Add one of your own battles from its .wotreplay file, no mod needed. It gets its own page with its replay, ready to share.
drop: Drop a .wotreplay here, or click to choose one
hint: Your own replays only, from a battle played to the end. They are in the replays folder of your game directory.

error.not_collected: Replay uploads are not available right now.
error.archive_full: Our replay storage is full for now. Try again later.
error.not_a_replay: That file is not a World of Tanks replay we can read.
error.unfinished: That replay was saved before the battle ended, so it has no results.
error.not_yours: That replay was recorded by another account. You can only upload your own.
error.wrong_region: That battle was played on another region than the account you are signed in with.
error.too_old: That battle is older than the ones we keep.
error.malformed: We could not read the results in that replay.
error.too_large: That file is larger than any replay we take (9 MB).
error.too_many_uploads: You have uploaded a lot in the last hour. Try again a bit later.
error.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
